about_the_game:
A new album of piano arrangements from the NieR series, which celebrates its 15th anniversary in April 2025.

Featuring newly arranged selections from NieR:Automata, NieR Re[in]carnation, and NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139..., this album brings the series' iconic melodies to life in stunning piano solos, performed by Benyamin Nuss.

Immerse yourself in 15 years of NieR’s musical legacy through the delicate and expressive sounds of the piano.
